title: Grade 5 French — Tue, Jun 10
description: La nourriture au marché — Day 2 of 5: Asking for food (Je voudrais...)
subject: french

questions.question: How do you say 'I would like...' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Je voudrais...' = I would like... It is the polite form of 'je veux' (I want). Always use in shops.

questions.question: How do you say 'I would like a kilo of apples, please.'?
options: Je veux un kilo de pommes.
Je voudrais un kilo de pommes, s'il vous plaît.
questions.explanation: 'Je voudrais un kilo de pommes, s'il vous plaît.' = I would like a kilo of apples, please. Always add 's'il vous plaît' in a shop.

questions.question: What does 'Avez-vous des tomates?' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Avez-vous des tomates?' = Do you have tomatoes? Formal question form (vous).

questions.question: How does a shopkeeper typically greet and ask what you need?
options: Bonjour! Qu'est-ce que vous désirez? / Vous désirez?
questions.explanation: 'Vous désirez?' or 'Qu'est-ce que vous désirez?' = What would you like? / Can I help you? — typical shopkeeper greeting.

questions.question: How do you say 'That's all, thank you.'?
questions.explanation: 'C'est tout, merci.' = That's all, thank you. Used when you've finished shopping.

questions.question: How do you say 'Have you got any strawberries?' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Avez-vous des fraises?' = Have you got any strawberries? 'Avez-vous...?' = Do you have...?

questions.question: Complete the shopping dialogue: 'Bonjour, ___ un kilo d'oranges, s'il vous plaît.'
questions.explanation: 'Bonjour, je voudrais un kilo d'oranges, s'il vous plaît.' — 'Je voudrais' is the polite form.

questions.question: What does 'Voilà, monsieur/madame.' mean in a shop context?
questions.explanation: 'Voilà' = here you are / there you go. The shopkeeper says this when handing over items.

questions.question: How do you ask for 'a bag' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Un sac' = a bag. 'Puis-je avoir un sac, s'il vous plaît?' = May I have a bag, please?

questions.question: Translate: 'Do you have organic apples?'
questions.explanation: 'Avez-vous des pommes biologiques?' = Do you have organic apples? 'Biologique/bio' = organic.

questions.question: Complete the polite shopping exchange: Customer: 'Je voudrais deux kilos de tomates.' Shopkeeper: '___ deux kilos. C'est tout?'
questions.explanation: 'Voilà deux kilos. C'est tout?' = Here are two kilos. Is that all? — typical shopkeeper response.

questions.question: How do you say 'I'll take a dozen eggs' in French?
options: Both A and B are correct.
questions.explanation: Both 'Je voudrais une douzaine d'œufs' (polite) and 'Je prends une douzaine d'œufs' (I'll take) are correct in a shop.

questions.question: What does 'Autre chose?' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Autre chose?' = Anything else? The shopkeeper asks this to see if you want more items.

questions.question: Translate: 'I would like half a kilo of butter, please.'
options: Je voudrais un kilo de beurre.
Je voudrais un demi-kilo de beurre, s'il vous plaît.
Je prends cinq cents grammes de beurre.
Both B and C are correct.
questions.explanation: B ('un demi-kilo') and C ('cinq cents grammes') both = half a kilo. Both are correct.

questions.question: Which phrase correctly ends a shopping transaction?
questions.explanation: 'C'est tout, merci. Au revoir!' = That's all, thank you. Goodbye! — standard polite ending.
